objective.text: Order a literal route before an unconstrained parameter route.

difficulty.rationale: Explain why a reserved literal is being interpreted as an identifier.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/teams/{team}', fn (string $team) => 'team '.$team);
Route::get('/teams/new', fn () => 'create form');

stem: GET /teams/new returns "team new". Both paths must remain available. What is the smallest routing correction?

options.rationale: Optionality broadens matching and does not protect the reserved literal.
options.misconception: Optionality broadens matching and does not protect the reserved literal.

options.rationale: The unconstrained parameter matches new; placing the literal first selects the form handler.

options.text: Rename the team placeholder to id.
options.rationale: Changing the placeholder name does not change the strings it matches.
options.misconception: Changing the placeholder name does not change the strings it matches.

options.rationale: Names affect URL generation, not precedence during matching.
